Here is your **fully built VSL script**, based directly on your foundation doc and the case studies you just refined. This is written in your voice, aligned with Luxora positioning, and structured to convert without feeling salesy.

---

## **LUXORA COLLECTIVE VSL SCRIPT**

---

### **HOOK (0:00–0:30)**

Most med spa owners don’t have a lead problem.

They have a system problem.

And until that’s fixed…  
More leads just create more chaos.

More no-shows.  
More unconverted consults.  
More pressure on a team that’s already stretched thin.

If your business feels heavier than it should at this stage…  
This is why.

---

### **IDENTITY + RELATABILITY (0:30–1:30)**

You didn’t get into this industry to manage spreadsheets and chase revenue targets.

You built this because you believe in transformation.  
In helping people feel confident.  
In creating something meaningful.

And somewhere along the way…  
You became the highest-paid employee in your own business.

Still making every decision.  
Still answering every question.  
Still wondering why growth feels so hard when you’re already this good at what you do.

If you’re generating somewhere between $500K to $2M a year…  
and you feel stuck, plateaued, or stretched…

You’re exactly who this is for.

---

### **PROBLEM REFRAME (1:30–2:30)**

Because what no one tells you is this:

Most med spas are sitting on tens of thousands… sometimes hundreds of thousands… in lost revenue every year.

Not because they aren’t talented.  
Not because they don’t care.  
But because the systems behind the business were never built to support growth.

Leads that don’t convert.  
Follow-up that never happens.  
Memberships that never took off.  
Clients who come once… and never come back.

It’s not a marketing issue.

It’s a revenue leak issue.

---

### **INTRODUCE LUXORA (2:30–3:30)**

I’m Bethany, founder of The Luxora Collective.

And we don’t run ads and hope for the best.

We install a full revenue operating system inside your business.

One that fixes what’s already broken…  
captures the revenue you’re already generating…  
and builds a foundation that actually supports growth.

This isn’t a course.  
It’s not a traditional agency.  
And it’s not surface-level coaching.

It’s a done-with-you partnership where we rebuild the way your business actually operates… from the inside out. fileciteturn1file0

---

### **MECHANISM (3:30–5:00)**

And everything starts with one thing:

A **Revenue Leak Audit**.

Before we ever talk about scaling…  
Before we ever suggest more ad spend…  

We map exactly where your business is losing money right now.

Most owners discover between **$50K to $200K in recoverable revenue**  
before they invest a single dollar into anything new. fileciteturn1file0

That becomes the foundation.

From there, we build:

- Memberships that actually fill  
- Packages that increase your average transaction  
- Follow-up systems that bring clients back automatically  
- A consult process that converts  
- And a client journey that turns one visit into long-term revenue  

This is how growth becomes predictable.

---

### **CASE STUDY – HANNAH (5:00–6:15)**

Let me give you a real example.

One of our clients, Hannah, was doing around **$45K/month**.

Great at what she did…  
but her business depended on one-time visits.

Clients would come in… spend once… and disappear.

No retention system.  
No memberships.  
No real structure for long-term revenue.

Within 90 days of working together:

She scaled to **$70K–$80K/month**  
Her client return rate more than doubled  
And her average client value increased over **2x**

That’s an additional **$25K–$35K per month**…  
without increasing lead volume.

Nothing new was added.

We just fixed what was already there.

---

### **FAST WIN – MIKE (6:15–7:15)**

And sometimes… it happens even faster.

Another client came to us stuck at **$37K/month**.

Leads were inconsistent.  
No-shows were climbing.  
Front desk was overwhelmed.

Within **30 days**:

His consult conversion went from **34% to 62%**  
Revenue jumped to **$55K/month**

No new staff.  
No promotions.  
No increase in ad spend.

Just better systems.

That’s the difference between adding more…  
and fixing what’s broken.

---

### **DIFFERENTIATION (7:15–8:15)**

This is why Luxora works when other agencies don’t.

Agencies give you content.  
We give you a system.

Freelancers fix one piece.  
We rebuild how everything works together.

Because your growth isn’t coming from more posts…  
it’s coming from:

- How your front desk converts  
- How your clients are guided  
- How your business retains and compounds revenue  

Those are business assets.

Not marketing deliverables.

---

### **OBJECTION HANDLING (8:15–9:15)**

If you’ve tried agencies before and it didn’t work…

That’s exactly why we start with the audit.

We don’t guess.  
We show you what’s broken first.

If you’re thinking “I don’t have time for this”…

That’s exactly why this works.

We do the heavy lifting.  
You spend about 2–4 hours a week guiding the changes. fileciteturn1file0

And if you’re wondering if it’s worth the investment…

The audit answers that.

Because when you can clearly see where $80K, $100K, $150K is already being lost…

The decision becomes obvious.

---

### **CLOSE + CTA (9:15–END)**

If any part of this feels familiar…

The next step is simple.

Book a call.

Not a long application.  
Not a waitlist.

A real conversation where we walk through your business together…  
and show you exactly where your revenue is leaking.

So you can finally see what’s possible…  
with the right systems in place.

Because you didn’t build this business to manage chaos.

You built it to create transformation.

And it’s time your business actually reflects that.

---
